description: `worktrees --merge` refuses when gitleaks reports a finding: it writes redacted evidence to .multiverse/evidence/<task>-secrets.txt and names that file in its own refusal, merging nothing. `/usr/bin/false` stands in for a gitleaks binary that found something (card 20261114-b-069836 requires a fake scanner on PATH, never the network) — it is a stand-in for the exit code only, not a real content scan; `mv-state`'s own unit tests cover a scanner that actually echoes planted secret text.

stderr_contains: secrets scan (gitleaks) found a match in <ID>'s commits
